cards.title: Acronym Collective Studio transforms former brewery in Czech Republic into community centre
cards.extract: Architecture firm Acronym Collective Studio has transformed a former brewery near Brno into a community centre, which addresses its corner site with a curved, perforated brick facade. cards.title: CASA MG / Startup Architettura
cards.extract: Located within a 1930s residential building, Casa MG reinterprets and elevates some of the period's most distinctive and iconic architectural features, making them a recurring design language at the heart of the apartment's spatial reorganization.
